python.known_blocker: livekit-agents 1.3.12 imports typing.TypeAlias, which is not available in the local Python 3.9 runtime.

core.reason: The governed boundary, payload guards, mock Kernel smoke and SDK availability checks must run with Python standard library only.

packages.purpose: Real LiveKit Agents SDK worker loop, room callbacks, turn detection and plugin orchestration.

optional_livekit.activation_gate: atlas ai voice sdk-check --json must report status=ready before wiring real SDK callbacks.
optional_livekit.probe_policy: Availability checks use importlib metadata/spec only. Scaffold code must not import LiveKit SDK modules while checking readiness.
optional_livekit.install_policy: Installation is operator-managed. The install plan may emit commands, but scaffold code must not run pip, import LiveKit SDK, start a daemon or mutate Kernel policy.
